تتابعت (form VI)
# تَتَابَعْتُ (tatābaʕtu) /ta.taː.baʕ.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# تَتَابَعْتَ (tatābaʕta) /ta.taː.baʕ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# تَتَابَعْتِ (tatābaʕti) /ta.taː.baʕ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَتَابَعَ (tatābaʕa)
# تَتَابَعَتْ (tatābaʕat) /ta.taː.ba.ʕat/: third-person fem
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
